focus.label: Pull the Starsilk thread
focus.description: Changes the weave itself. The weave, the stars and the worlds all answer.

focus.label: Open the Egg: Fault-Tongue
focus.description: Fault-Tongue — canonical process function. A source-supported process reference for structural splitting and geological fracture.

focus.label: Turn the dismantling clock
focus.description: Moves the station from Month Zero to Month Six. Every production of this project — the song, the story, the visuals, the tour — shares this one timeline.

focus.label: Select: Syrin is fixed
focus.description: A hard canon lock. Everything downstream of it is decided. Watch how much of the graph stays dark — those regions are unresolved, and unresolved does not mean allowed.

focus.label: Draw a different path
focus.description: Traces a new path through the loom. The mechanism follows the canon rules for how Starsilk behaves, so every result is a legal configuration of the material.

focus.label: Show canon invariants
focus.description: Switches the constellation from folio view to machine-readable canon-lock view.

focus.label: Inject positive Syrin contact
focus.description: Any positive contact nullifies the active Starsilk runtime. This is a hard exception, not a resistance roll.

focus.label: Examine YEAR 121: Ruby Eclipse
focus.description: The Administration assaults a Drakken forward node in the Pharos Nebula. The Siege of the Ruby Eclipse follows. A decisive battle can still fail to end the machinery of a war.

focus.label: Try another example
focus.description: Compare examples from a quiet room, a noisy room, and technical vocabulary. The exhibit uses prepared examples and never requests a microphone.

focus.label: Forget the topmost entry
focus.description: Marks an entry forgotten. The entry does not vanish — the record shows that something was forgotten and when. A forget button that leaves no mark is not a memory control.

focus.label: Use the manual control instead
focus.description: Sends the same command as the "Roll right" gesture (Volume up) with a button press instead. The novel input is never the only input — that is what keeps it from being a novelty.

focus.label: Audit and sort the files
focus.description: Sorts the sample files and shows which can be rebuilt and which need a decision.

focus.label: Produce the next-action packet
focus.description: Derives the next action from the state of the file rather than a generic checklist. It needs the whole chronology locked, because a partial timeline produces the wrong next step.

focus.label: Advance 2D Game Factory: Import
focus.description: Advances a museum-scale model of the real workbench path. The actual project previews its generated Phaser game rather than an editor mock; this exhibit represents that contract without executing the external factory.

focus.label: Raise layer: Tectonic boundaries
focus.description: Geology, unrelated to either of the above. All layers here are bundled sample data — no live map service is contacted.

focus.label: Select region: Saltfen
focus.description: Movement costs are the mechanic here, so the terrain identifier does real work. Identifier reg_saltfen, 1 unit record.

focus.label: Change whose turn it is
focus.description: Steps the initiative order. The active miniature lifts.

focus.label: Toggle overlay: Speech bubble
focus.description: The cat-and-bubble presentation the family is known for. Toggling again sets it click-through, which is what stops an always-on-top window from becoming an obstacle.

focus.label: Resolve one combat turn
focus.description: Runs a single deterministic turn against the void. The same placement always produces the same result, so the table can be argued with.

focus.label: Explode the ship
focus.description: Separates the five modules. Each fails differently, and the differences are the simulation — a generation ship is a set of coupled failure modes.

focus.label: Cast or advance the semantic ability
focus.description: Runs telegraph, travel, impact, field and residue as distinct deterministic stages. The final stage commits persistent aftermath.

focus.label: Start rolling
focus.description: One short self-contained level: roll through the town, pick up anything smaller than you are, and watch what becomes collectible as you grow.

focus.label: Claim the next wave of nodes
focus.description: Expands from what you already hold, as far as the chosen technology reaches. The expansion is deterministic — the same seed and the same choices always produce the same map.

focus.label: Turn the museum timeline
focus.description: Steps through the museum’s own forms. The current building is described as active development, not as a completed release.

focus.label: Send the record through
focus.description: Feeds one lore record into the first machine. It passes through all three generations; watch how much apparatus each one needs to do the same job.

focus.label: Run the preflight
focus.description: Tests a fictional remote mutation against the selected authority record and any active temporary constraint.

focus.label: Move the rhetoric lens
focus.description: Advances the lens passage by passage through the fictional article fixture.

focus.label: Raise Voice
focus.description: Voice is the melodic line the lyric actually sits on. Raising it changes the shape of the waveform in front of you.

focus.label: Disable the DexEnhance layer
focus.description: Toggles only the local extension surface. Its state is independent from the synthetic host layout and no remote account or service exists in this exhibit.

focus.label: Authorize the selected capability
focus.description: Creates authority for the exact selected candidate. The scanned repository cannot authorize itself.

focus.label: Change character representation
focus.description: Changes the visible rendering target while preserving the same captured performance state.

focus.label: Select Restart registered service
focus.description: A consequential action requires an exact preview transaction before the simulated route may execute. Permission class: consequential.

focus.label: Run the next face operation
focus.description: Detect, landmark, analyse. Every face here is procedurally generated — no real likeness is present, and the stack has no outbound network path.

focus.label: Wind the crank
focus.description: The first treat drops. Each mechanism escalates the last — three linked movements and it is over, which is the whole game.

focus.label: Draw a miracle
focus.description: One verb, implemented deeply. The gesture is the act rather than a menu choice, and the world answers on the same frame.

focus.label: Authorize the selected capability
focus.description: Creates authority for the exact selected candidate. The scanned repository cannot authorize itself.

methods.passageProbe: Real player, explicit starting fixtures, stepped input simulation and geometry ray probes.
methods.continuousSimulatedTour: Real player, held W, stepped simulation, no diagnostic reposition after spawn.
methods.continuousActiveLoopWalk: Real player, real W and F, live app frames, automated steering, no diagnostic reposition after spawn.
methods.activeLoopBayProbes: Independent hall-side starting fixtures followed by real W input and live app frames.
